glosses: to believe, to trust [with dative ‘what/whom’] [with w (+ accusative) ‘what’] (to place confidence in, to rely on, to confide in)

examples.text: […] będzieszli wiernie dufać Panu swemu a będziesz chodził prawdziwemi drogami Jego[…]
examples.translation: […] thou'lt faithfully trust in thy Lord, and walk in His true ways […]
examples.english: […] thou'lt faithfully trust in thy Lord, and walk in His true ways […]

examples.text: Dufam, że bezpiecznie dotrzecie do Tyru, miła pani – powiedział swym aksamitnym, dostojnym głosem.
examples.translation: I trust that you will reach Tyre safely, kind lady, he said in his velvety, dignified voice.
examples.english: I trust that you will reach Tyre safely, kind lady, he said in his velvety, dignified voice.
